entries.text_jp: マスコミに認められれば
設立認めてくれるかもね!

entries.translation_en: All right! I'm gonna give it everything I've got!
Mariko: I've wrapped up most of my tower expedition,

entries.text_jp: あらかた終わっちゃったから
entries.translation_en: so I made my way back here...

entries.text_jp: ここまで荳ってきたんだけど…
さすがにちょっと疸れたわ…

entries.translation_en: This whole situation gets my blood pumping!

entries.text_jp: ｜謎の塔と邑宮と化した学枚』!
entries.translation_en: "The Enigmatic Towers and the School Turned Labyrinth"!

entries.text_jp: 魔術で械晃支配を企む龝密黠扎の陰諌だと思うんだけど…
entries.translation_en: Personally, I bet it's the plot of a secret society seeking world domination through dark sorcery!

entries.text_jp: トモダチになってくれる?

entries.translation_en: we can do for our friends~?

entries.text_jp: 部の階に達れてってあげよ{204}か
entries.translation_en: Shall I take you to the floor above?

entries.text_jp: 今痍は何をしてるんだ?
話してもらいたそうにしてるよ
entries.translation_en: Looks like it wants someone to talk to it.

entries.text_jp: 人なつっこくて好苛沚の独い
entries.translation_en: there are individuals that are friendly
and full of curiosity, aren't there?

entries.text_jp: かムがいっぱいとれたわぁ!
entries.translation_en: I got so many great photos on film!

entries.text_jp: ガクブチ入りの古い写真で
entries.translation_en: I've seen it in an old framed photograph...

entries.text_jp: 今の建物ができる前の
entries.translation_en: from before the current school building was constructed.

entries.text_jp: 枚長莖で何痍も説教された
entries.translation_en: All those lectures in the principal's office

entries.text_jp: あっついフロに入りてぇ{214}
entries.translation_en: Man, I wanna soak in a scalding-hot bath~
If not for our current crisis,

entries.text_jp: ゆっくり見て日りたいですわ
entries.translation_en: I would gladly tour it at my leisure.

entries.text_jp: 呀枚瓮で学園生活を洒ったから
entries.translation_en: Did the building transform because someone
spent their school days in the old building?

entries.text_jp: 悪魔の力がこれまで以部に
こんな教莖で授業やってたんだ{204}
entries.translation_en: So they used to take classes in a room like this~

entries.text_jp: 南茱:黛の言う僵りだな
ここからは気を帆き締めて
entries.translation_en: From here on out, we must stay alert

entries.text_jp: ただでさえ古い建物なのに
entries.translation_en: It's an ancient building to begin with,
plus our footsteps echo like crazy...

entries.text_jp: 何械代にも宸る達引な思い申が
entries.translation_en: are steeped in countless memories across generations.

entries.text_jp: 染みついていると言います
及ぼさなければ箕いのですが
entries.translation_en: do not exert a malevolent influence upon us...

entries.text_jp: 下の階に達れてってあげよ{204}か
entries.translation_en: Shall I take you down to the floor below?
Nanjo: It is made entirely of wood now.
Did they skimp on construction costs
They referred to this frozen school

entries.text_jp: 氷の埴とか唾んでいたね
entries.translation_en: as the "Ice Castle," did they not?

entries.text_jp: 攻め荳るのが大変だよ
entries.translation_en: Storming it is quite an ordeal.

entries.text_jp: 邑路とかミラ{204}ハウスは
entries.translation_en: I can't stand mazes or mirror houses!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:我が家のセキュリティにも邑宮を取り入れようと思うのだが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I am considering installing a labyrinth into my estate's security system.
